title: College Football Week Ahead
subject: CFB Week 3: LSU–Ole Miss leads 7 games worth researching
preview_text: No book number is joined to this week’s featured games, so these are model-only reads. Research, not picks.

paragraphs: EdgeDesk scored 75 upcoming college football games for Week 3 and put 7 in front of you.
No featured game this week carries a joined sportsbook number, so there is no model-versus-market comparison to make. What follows is EdgeDesk’s own view of each matchup and what it cannot see.

market.why: No sportsbook spread is currently joined to this game.

why.text: On EdgeDesk’s own ETSR (overall) scale it has Ole Miss #15 of 68 at +5.2 and LSU #5 of 68 at +9.1.

why.source: matchups.Ole Miss pass offense vs LSU pass defense
why.text: Ole Miss’s pass offense rates 47.0 (#44 of 67) against LSU’s pass defense at 73.0 (#1 of 68). LSU’s unit stands higher among its own position group, by 43 places.
Ole Miss carries the wider measured edge on Kicking — 58.7 · #1 of 68 against LSU’s 54.9 · #58 of 68.
